actions.label: Synthesize Knowledge
actions.description: Compare evidence from multiple authorized sources and build a coherent knowledge map.

actions.description: Identify conflicting claims, scope differences and uncertainty before teaching a conclusion.

actions.description: Generate unseen tasks that test whether the learned concept transfers.
